result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner uses white text on a very light background, making it nearly unreadable and failing accessibility contrast.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white on a very light mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast and barely readable text.
issues.suggestion: Change banner text to a dark color with sufficient contrast against the light background, or darken the banner background if white text must be kept to meet WCAG contrast requirements.
